name: cover
summary: Centers a primary task between optional top and bottom regions.

agent.useWhen: One focused primary task needs optional product and support regions at opposite edges.
agent.avoidWhen: The middle region requires bounded scrolling; use Pane instead.

invariants: Primary content follows optional top and precedes optional bottom slots.
Optional chrome never changes primary-row placement.
Neutral wrappers add no landmarks, controls, scripts, routes, or commands.
